title: Recordify
description: Wanna be a Youtuber? use it :)
body:
# 🎬 Recordify — The Ultimate Creator Ecosystem > A performance-first, utility-heavy Minecraft modpack tailored specifically for video creators, streamers, and animators. Built on the **Fabric** loader for Minecraft, it delivers maximum FPS output even during intensive active recording, streaming, or background rendering. --- ## 🚀 Overview Most modpacks force you to choose between beautiful visuals and raw game performance. **Recordify** bridges that gap for content creators. By stripping out vanilla rendering inefficiencies and layering in top-tier cinematic tools, this pack functions as a fully optimized standalone digital studio. Whether you are capturing high-tier PvP montage clips, scripting multi-perspective SMP storylines, or setting up pixel-perfect thumbnail compositions, this pack provides the exact environment you need without dropping frames. --- ## 🛠️ Complete Mod Manifest
🎥 View Creator, Cinema & Studio Core Mods * **Flashback** (`0.39.5`) – The cutting-edge modern replacement for Replay Mod. Records and renders smooth tracking paths. * **Flashback Extras** (`1.0.0`) – Additional tools and optimization specific to the Flashback system. * **FlashPlus** (`1.2.0`) – Enhanced extension utility for managing recording assets. * **NPC Studio** (`1.2.0`) – Powerhouse tool for spawning, animating, lighting, and custom-posing characters for thumbnail generation and skits. * **Fabrishot** (`1.16.4`) – Takes massive, hyper-resolution screenshot renders for crisp thumbnail design. * **Zoomify** (`2.15.2`) – Smooth, modern, customizable camera zoom mechanics. * **Camera Utils** (`1.0.4`) – Adds smooth camera movements, cinematic panning, and detachable cameras. * **Freecam** (`1.2.5`) – Lets you look around your area or builds without moving your actual character.
⚡ View Extreme Performance & Engine Tweaks * **Sodium** (`0.8.12`) – Core rendering framework overhaul maximizing frame output. * **Lithium** (`0.21.4`) – Heavy physics and server-side game-logic optimization. * **BadOptimizations** (`2.4.1`) – Removes unnecessary micro-stutters by fixing inefficient vanilla rendering paths. * **FerriteCore** (`8.2.0`) – Massive memory savings, drastically reducing RAM footprint to leave room for OBS/streaming apps. * **Dynamic FPS** (`3.11.6`) – Automatically throttles frame rates when the game is tabbed out, saving CPU cycles. * **More Culling** (`1.6.2`) – Extends occlusion culling to unviewable particles, entities, and blocks. * **ImmediatelyFast** (`1.14.2`) – Speeds up rendering loops for immediate elements like nameplates, signs, and text fields.
🔊 View Interaction, Multiplayer & Chat Mods * **Simple Voice Chat** (`2.6.18`) – Clean, low-latency proximity audio built for SMP group collabs and interactions. * **Chat Heads** (`1.2.4`) – Visually appends the player's skin head next to chat text for easy tracking during frantic multiplayer sessions. * **Krypton** (`0.2.10`) – Optimizes your networking stack to drastically reduce ping and connection lag.
